name: How long does trauma scene cleanup take?

mainEntity.name: How long does trauma scene cleanup take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of trauma scene cleanup varies significantly depending on the size and scope of the affected area, the type and volume of biohazardous materials, and the surfaces contaminated. A smaller incident might take a few hours, while larger or more complex scenes could require one to several days to complete the cleaning, disinfection, and deodorization processes thoroughly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time varies based on scene size and contamination, from a few hours for small incidents to several days for larger ones.
